description: What launching takes now for your wallet, as the site's launch form reads it: allowed and its reason, venues (meteora: Souvenir's own curve; pump: pump.fun), feeLevels and shareLevels in basis points, defaults, tickets (the ticket rules), holdHours, which prize kinds are open, basket, pump (pump.fun's fees; on BTC pairs its feeLevels, and shield and devBuy: whether the launch shield and a dev buy are open to you), souv (coins paired with $SOUVENIR: on, whether they are open to your wallet now; feeLevels and defaultFeeBps; heldSouv, maxFirstBuySouv and raiseSouv in raw $SOUVENIR; solPerSouv) and more. Takes the token from sign_in, as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header. Refused with "Launching through the API is not open yet." (403 not_open) only if Souvenir pauses launching through the API. Launching a coin, in order: (1) sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with that wallet, then sign_in for a token; (2) launch_options, and search_prizes for the prize (or shopper_sample for a coin that picks its own prizes); (3) prepare_launch; (4) sign the transaction it answers with your wallet, without sending it, and give it to submit_launch; (5) launch_status until it answers confirmed: a pump.fun launch first answers split with a second transaction, which you sign (or sign and send) and give to submit_split, then launch_status again. Your wallet pays and signs everything: Souvenir never needs or asks for its private key.

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
